# mtncloud_storage_bucket (Data Source)

Provides an MTN Cloud storage bucket data source: looks up a storage bucket (for example a MOS bucket) by name or ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_storage_bucket" "tf_example_bucket" {
  name = "TF Example Bucket"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) The ID of the storage bucket
- `name` (String) The name of the storage bucket
